scenes.say: How does dbt help turn raw data into analytics-ready models, and why do interviewers care?

scenes.label: Layers
scenes.sub: Models are staged as raw, cleaned, and business-ready.
scenes.say: dbt organizes models into layers—raw, cleaned, and business-ready—mirroring the medallion architecture.
Start with staging models, add joins in intermediate, then aggregate in marts for analytics.
I use dbt's ref function to manage model dependencies and ensure reproducible builds.

scenes.question: What does dbt add to SQL modeling?
scenes.right: Adds version control, testing, and layered modeling for analytics.
scenes.say: Interviewers want more than SQL automation—dbt adds version control, testing, and layered modeling.
